questions.stem_text: What contributes to societies becoming more complex?

options.A: Surplus food is stored in large, collective facilities.
options.B: Crop irrigation requires the construction of dams or canals.
options.C: Sedentary communities need to defend themselves.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - All of the above.

questions.stem_text: The Upper Paleolithic is generally associated with:

options.A: new and improved stone tool technologies.
options.B: a broadening of the subsistence base.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following dating techniques are based on the measurement of the amount of
energy trapped in materials that have been heated at archaeological sites?

options.C: luminescence dating and optically stimulated luminescence

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - luminescence dating and optically stimulated luminescence

questions.stem_text: Which of the following was described as "the slow agency of existing causes"?
The origins of Chinese civilization can be traced to:

options.A: the site of An-yang near the Huang ho River.
options.B: chiefdoms and states in numerous regions throughout China.
options.C: the beginning of the Qin Dynasty.
options.D: external influences originating from the Indus Valley.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - chiefdoms and states in numerous regions throughout China.
